agenda.intro:
Pick a day on the calendar to see its appointments.
Past dates cannot be used for new bookings.
Select an appointment in the list and send it to the workshop with the blue button.
agenda.add_tooltip_future: Book for an existing or new client.
agenda.add_tooltip_past: Appointments cannot be scheduled on past dates.

reports.matplotlib_missing:
Matplotlib is not installed in this Python environment.

In a terminal, using the same interpreter as this app, run:
  python -m pip install matplotlib

Then restart Garage Manager. Tables and figures still work without the chart.
